letter.title: Behind the index in a month led by the AI platforms
sections: Strategy Inc rose 15%, but silver fell 11%, the pipeline companies fell as interest rates rose, and our protection against a drop in chip stocks lost value as they rallied 9%. The portfolio owns little of the big AI platforms that led the Nasdaq-100.

We sold Cleveland-Cliffs at $12.99, 12% above its August close, and bought Hyosung Heavy Industries, a Korean maker of large power transformers. We also doubled the protection against a sharp fall in chip stocks.

We continue to hold selected AI bottlenecks while keeping a reserve for better entry prices. The reserve is 23% of the portfolio, including cash, short-term bonds and put protection. AI-related holdings remain below their long-term ranges until prices reach the levels set for them.
Late-October results from Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon and Meta: is AI spending still rising, and is AI revenue catching up with it? And US long-term interest rates, now above 5%.
